title: AES-CTR: counter advance is O(blocks) loop, could be 128-bit add
description: After AES-CTR encrypt/decrypt, port.c:764-774 advances aes->reg by iterating block-by-block with an inner byte-carry loop. Cost is O(n/16) iterations. Alternative: compute blocks=(data_sz+15)/16, add blocks to the 128-bit big-endian counter in one pass (one 128-bit add). For a 1MB CTR block, the current code does 65536 loop iterations; the 128-bit add does 1. Not a bottleneck for TLS record sizes (max 1024 iterations per 16KB record) but measurably slower for bulk CTR encryption. The loop is correct; this is a gratuitous inefficiency.
